criteria.text: I can check a plan before parts have prompts, Stories or tests, with no server, model, authentication, runtime slot or file change.
I see a nonzero result with a file, record and field when a shared schema, reference or eligible inline copy is wrong.
I can link each world key explicitly to its schema and check every present seed value with one declared writer.
I can leave a declared world key out of the starting seed and repeat an identical ownership row without failing.
I see unavailable validation instead of a pass or an invented mismatch when a required selected schema or value predicate cannot be established locally.
I can use array and primitive component schemas, JSON schema containers and seed data without confusing their roles.
I keep exact JSON numbers and own keys, and my local check leaves all source and expected values unchanged.
I can still list contracts and preview migration with their advisory behavior; invalid check combinations are command errors.
I can plan without world files when both are absent, while a missing partner or broken explicit schema link identifies what needs fixing.

boundary: real CLI argv or runContracts with real safe Git-visible filesystem discovery; no Runtime entry is claimed

setup.case_files: Each case starts from base_files, applies delete_files then set_files, all Git-visible. JSON content strings are exact authored bytes. No fixture describes a live app.
setup.observations: diagnostics entries require file/record/field substrings in one finite diagnostic, not exact prose; kind unavailable must say unavailable. checked counts are exact only where supplied. Calls are independent spies; preserve every before/after source byte. Plain listing/sync may read local history; --check must not. Missing optional expected fields do not authorize skipping declared observations.
